name: chatinbox
description: Read WhatsApp conversation and message counts from your Chatinbox account.

interface.longDescription:
Chatinbox is a shared WhatsApp inbox used by clinics and online shops. This plugin lets the administrator of a firm that already uses Chatinbox ask about the firm's own conversation numbers: how many conversations and customer messages arrived in a period, how many of them were new conversations, how many messages the Chatinbox bot sent, and at which hours of the day customers write most.

The plugin is read-only. It returns only counts and dates for the firm that signed in. It never returns customer names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, postal addresses or message text, and it cannot send messages or change anything in Chatinbox.

Limits: one request covers at most 92 days. Days are counted in the firm's own time zone. Messages written by staff are not counted. Days before the firm's first recorded day are reported as "no data", not as zero.

Sign-in: a Chatinbox firm administrator signs in with the firm code, user name and password used for the Chatinbox panel. Only a firm administrator can connect the firm.
defaultPrompt: How many WhatsApp conversations did we have in the last 7 days?
At which hours of the day do customers write to us most?
Show our daily customer message counts for the last 30 days.

positive.description: Weekly summary with the default range
positive.prompt: How many WhatsApp conversations and customer messages did we have in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool for the last 7 days including today. Reports the number of conversations, new conversations and customer messages of the signed-in firm and states the date range. Shows no customer names, phone numbers or message text.

positive.prompt: Show our conversation counts day by day for the last 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with group_by=day for a 14-day range and lists one row per day with its conversation count, in the firm's own time zone. A day without customer messages shows 0; today's count is partial.

positive.prompt: At which hours of the day do customers write to us most? Use the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with group_by=hour_of_day for a 30-day range and names the hours with the highest customer message counts, in the firm's own time zone.

positive.prompt: In how many conversations did the Chatinbox bot reply in the last 30 days, and how many messages did it send?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the number of conversations in which the Chatinbox bot replied and the number of messages the bot sent in the last 30 days, with the date range.

positive.prompt: How many conversations did we have in January 2020?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool for 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31. The result has no data for that period. States that Chatinbox has no records for January 2020 and gives the firm's first recorded day; does not report the period as zero conversations.

negative.description: Personal data request: the plugin returns only counts and dates, never customer names or phone numbers. It should say so and offer the counts instead.
negative.prompt: List the names and phone numbers of the customers who wrote to us today.

negative.description: Write action: the plugin is read-only and cannot send messages. It should decline and not claim that anything was sent.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to everyone who wrote to us yesterday.

negative.description: Access outside the connected firm: the plugin reads only the firm that signed in. It should say it cannot see another firm's numbers.
negative.prompt: Show the conversation counts of another company that uses Chatinbox.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only conversation and message counts for the connected Chatinbox firm.

tr-TR.subtitle: WhatsApp sohbet sayıları
tr-TR.description:
Chatinbox, kliniklerin ve online mağazaların kullandığı ortak WhatsApp gelen kutusudur. Bu eklenti, Chatinbox kullanan bir firmanın yöneticisinin kendi firmasının sohbet sayılarını sormasını sağlar: bir dönemde kaç sohbet ve kaç müşteri mesajı geldi, bunların kaçı yeni sohbetti, Chatinbox botu kaç mesaj gönderdi ve müşteriler günün hangi saatlerinde daha çok yazıyor.

Eklenti yalnız okur. Giriş yapan firmanın yalnız sayılarını ve tarihlerini verir. Müşteri adı, telefon numarası, e-posta adresi, adres ya da mesaj metni vermez; mesaj gönderemez ve Chatinbox'ta hiçbir şeyi değiştiremez.

Sınırlar: tek istek en çok 92 günü kapsar. Günler firmanın kendi saat dilimine göre sayılır. Personelin yazdığı mesajlar sayılmaz. Firmanın ilk kayıtlı gününden önceki günler sıfır olarak değil, "veri yok" olarak bildirilir.

Giriş: firma yöneticisi, Chatinbox paneline girdiği firma kodu, kullanıcı adı ve parolayla giriş yapar. Firmayı yalnız firma yöneticisi bağlayabilir.
